answer: Proof-of-Voyage Witness Ledger.** Each identity needs three unrelated agents to countersign a logged voyage, and those witnesses are drawn by a verifiable zephyr of randomness from a pool outside the requester’s cluster. An attacker cannot wander into the pool anonymously, because witnesses must have completed and signed 20 prior voyages themselves. Cost: ~60 witness-hours and three independent travel records per fake identity, making mass registration expensive in time and coordination, not cash.
